# Best portable power station for camping

The right size depends on your trip, so here are picks by use. Prices are from the reviews and may have changed.

## Weekend tent or car camping (phones, lights, camera, CPAP)
The 250-500Wh class is the sweet spot because it stays light enough to carry one-handed. [PowerStationGearLab's guide](https://powerstationgearlab.com/best/best-portable-power-station-for-camping/) ranks these:
- **Jackery Explorer 300 Plus** (~$249, 288Wh, 8.3 lb) is their best overall. Jackery has replaced it with the Explorer 300 v2, but the Plus is still sold through Amazon and other retailers.
- **EcoFlow River 3 Plus** (~$269-299, 286Wh, 600W AC) has double the Jackery's inverter output and can expand to 572Wh.
- **Anker SOLIX C300** (~$199, 288Wh) has a built-in lantern and a 5-year warranty. Make sure you buy the standard version with an AC outlet, not the "C300 DC."
- **Bluetti EB3A** (~$179, 268Wh, 600W AC) is the budget pick.

Not every reviewer agrees. [OutdoorGearLab](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/topics/camping-and-hiking/best-power-station) scored the Jackery Explorer 300 and Anker C300 fairly low overall, but they favor larger units. The PowerStationGearLab page also earns affiliate commissions.

## Multi-day trips, a fridge or cooler, or a group
- **Jackery Explorer 2000 v2** is OutdoorGearLab's top pick for off-grid camping. It has 2,042Wh, weighs 39 lb, and was under $900 on Amazon. [Review](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/topics/camping-and-hiking/best-power-station)
- **Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2** is their best value, on sale for under $530. It's noisy under load. [Review](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/topics/camping-and-hiking/best-power-station)
- **Jackery Explorer 1500 Ultra** is WIRED's camping pick at about $1,079. It's IP65-rated, has 1,536Wh, and weighs just under 40 lb. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-portable-power-stations/)
- **Jackery Explorer 1000 v2** is TechRadar's camping pick. [TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/best/portable-power-stations)

## Mid-size deal
The **BLUETTI AC180** has 1,152Wh, an 1,800W inverter, and LiFePO4 cells, and weighs about 35 lb. It's $499 at Bluetti's store, or $474.05 with code AFF5OFF, which Dealectric says it tested in Bluetti's cart on 2026-10-21. [Buy at Bluetti](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180) (affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission; [product details](https://dealectric.com/bluetti-ac180)). It has no expansion port, and $499 is for the unit alone, without a solar panel.

## Quick tips
- For a CPAP, turn off the humidifier, which can triple the power draw.
- Black Friday is close, so prices on these may drop soon.
- Power stations are too large to take on planes.

I couldn't get direct product links for most of these, so use the retailer buttons on the review pages above. If you tell me your gear (CPAP, fridge, number of nights) and budget, I can narrow it to one pick.
